commands.review_summary:
The PR adds MiniMax Token Plan recharge-credit fetching from a cookie-authenticated console endpoint, exposes pointsBalance in diagnostics/menu data, persists resolved API region, and adds docs plus focused tests.

Reproducibility: not applicable. as a user bug reproduction, but the main review finding is source-reproducible: MINIMAX_HOST=platform.minimaxi.com with global region returns www.minimax.io in the added test. The real recharge-balance behavior still lacks live proof.
commands.review_followup: - [P1] The remaining work needs contributor or maintainer live MiniMax proof plus a small routing fix; automation cannot supply the real account proof for an external PR.

target.title: Fetch MiniMax Token Plan recharge credit balance
target.body:
## Summary

- MiniMax Coding Plan / Token Plan **remains APIs do not expose the console recharge-credit balance** (积分余额). CodexBar now fetches it from the web console endpoint `GET /backend/account/token_plan_credit` on `www.minimaxi.com` / `www.minimax.io` when a browser session cookie is available.
- Web-session refreshes always attempt the credit fetch after quota/billing enrichment (even when billing history is disabled).
- API-token refreshes merge recharge credits only when an **explicit** manual or environment cookie is configured (not cached browser cookies), using the **resolved API region** after global→China retry and preserving curl `x-group-id` overrides.
- Credit enrichment is best-effort for auth/transport/parser failures but **propagates cancellation** like the other MiniMax optional enrichments.
- `MINIMAX_HOST` no longer rewrites the credit endpoint to `platform.*`; use `MINIMAX_TOKEN_PLAN_CREDIT_URL` for proxies.
- Diagnostics export includes `pointsBalance`; menu rendering reuses the existing `MiniMax points balance` cost row.

## Review follow-up (972cffac)

- [x] Propagate `CancellationError` / `URLError.cancelled` from `attachingTokenPlanCreditIfAvailable`
- [x] Fix duplicate `0.37.3` changelog heading drift
- [x] Preserve `MiniMaxCookieOverride.groupID` from curl/manual cookies on the API enrichment path
- [x] Stop auto-merging cached browser cookies into API-key refreshes
- [x] Use `fetchAPITokenUsage(...).resolvedRegion` for credit host selection after global→China retry
- [x] Keep credit fetches on `www.*` under `MINIMAX_HOST` overrides

## Motivation

Users with recharge credits (e.g. 20,000 points in the MiniMax console) saw quota data via API key but `providerCostPresent: false` in diagnostics and no balance in the menu. The balance lives on a separate cookie-authenticated endpoint discovered from the platform web bundle.

## Test plan

- [x] `swift test --filter MiniMaxTokenPlanCreditTests` (10 tests)
- [x] `make check`
- [x] Parser coverage for `remaining_credits`, `balance_breakdown.total_balance`, and `total_credits - used_credits`
- [x] Web + API enrichment paths via `ProviderHTTPTransportStub`
- [x] Cancellation propagation, curl group-id forwarding, resolved China region, host-override behavior

## Behavior proof

**API-only account (no explicit cookie):** built PR CLI on this branch

```bash
.build/debug/CodexBarCLI diagnose --provider minimax --format json --pretty
```

→ `source: api`, quota present, `pointsBalance` omitted (expected; cookie required).

**Cookie + session (expected after explicit cookie config):** redacted diagnose shape when `token_plan_credit` succeeds:

```json
{
  "provider": "minimax",
  "source": "api",
  "providerCostPresent": true,
  "details": {
    "planName": "Max",
    "pointsBalance": 20000
  }
}
```

Live console endpoint response shape used in fixtures/tests (`remaining_credits: 20000`, `base_resp.status_code: 0`). Contributor account currently has API key only; attaching a redacted menu/diagnose screenshot after configuring MiniMax manual cookie or `MINIMAX_COOKIE` is the remaining live proof step.

## Notes for reviewers

- Bearer API key alone still cannot read `token_plan_credit` (console returns `not login`); cookie is required for the balance.
- Optional override: `MINIMAX_TOKEN_PLAN_CREDIT_URL`
- Docs: `docs/minimax.md`
